verdict.rationale: Baseten clearly documents deploying custom/open-source models on 'dedicated GPUs' or 'dedicated infrastructure' separate from the shared Model APIs pool (baseten-docs-2, baseten-docs-17, baseten-docs-30), and describes active-active multi-cluster provisioning via MCM for capacity handling (baseten-docs-15, baseten-docs-46). However, the evidence never explicitly describes autoscaling behavior (scale-up/down policies, replica scaling) for dedicated deployments. Missing for 10: explicit autoscaling documentation/configuration for dedicated GPU deployments, and independent confirmation of traffic isolation from the serverless pool.
